name: Russia–NATO
value: Baltic drone alerts 10–11 Nov; no Article 4
summary: Drones from Belarus set off Baltic shelter alerts on 10–11 Nov; Finland reported a strike on a Russian warship on 13 Nov
state: Air-raid warnings were issued across Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia overnight on 10–11 Nov as drones entered from Belarus; NATO jets twice failed to down one over northern Lithuania and its origin is unconfirmed (Euronews; Reuters via Al-Monitor). On 13 Nov Finland's military said it had detected a strike on a Russian warship in the Gulf of Finland area and that Finland faced no immediate military threat (Al Jazeera). No Article 4 request, direct clash or attack on NATO territory was found as of 14 Nov, so Watch holds.
for_you: People in the Baltic states and Finland should follow alerts from their national crisis and emergency agencies. Short flight restrictions near the eastern borders are possible. UK travellers can check FCDO travel advice for each country.
rubric_hit: Watch: drone airspace violations over Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia on 10–11 Nov; no Article 4, clash or attack on NATO territory
